findings: ZIP 01860 (Merrimac) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.

Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01860 (Merrimac) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
